entries.reason: R9-GA-F1 root-fix (owner-authorized W2 recovery-defect boundary): replaceIndexedDbSnapshot was non-atomic on synchronous queueing failures — a put() throw (e.g. DataCloneError) escaped the Promise executor before the onerror/onabort handlers were attached, so the readwrite transaction auto-committed the already-queued clear()+put() requests and destroyed the previous state while the caller received an honest failure (proven experimentally on fake-indexeddb at Gate A). The fix wraps the queueing section in try/catch, calls a guarded transaction.abort() on throw, and rethrows the original error so the failure payload is byte-identical to today's contract. Growth = the try/catch scaffold + two dated header comment blocks; no behavior change on any success or async-failure path (regression proof: rollbackRehearsal.r9.test.ts leg 1 fails with the abort disabled, passes with it; legs 2-4 and the full storage/transfers suites green).
